required_mounts.decomp: the pret/pokefirered checkout, the directory holding firered.sha1 and src/ -- it must live outside this repository, since a mount nested inside the workspace hangs sbx create (tools/host-prep.sh defaults to ~/.cache/speedrun-frlg/decompiled)
required_mounts.deps: the prebuilt toolchain tree that tools/host-prep.sh fills in, the directory holding a .frlg-deps marker (it defaults to ~/.cache/speedrun-frlg/deps)
required_mounts.artifacts: writable scratch that outlives a sandbox, the directory holding a .frlg-artifacts marker that tools/host-prep.sh creates (it defaults to ~/.cache/speedrun-frlg/artifacts); must be given as PATH:rw
